title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar

messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Part 370010 – price basis 2027 onwards
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your offer. Your letter doc:20260706-70710-M1 confirms that your nickel and alloy requirement is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so the AS-14404 rise will not reach your costs early in the new period. Our category estimate part:370010 puts the AS-14404 cost share at 43%, not 45%. Your scorecard sc:70710@2026Q3 shows 75 ppm and 88% OTD, which does not support a premium.

In return we offer a 24- or 36-month commitment without an index clause. Please see the attached term sheets. Could your owner share the cost breakdown he offered, and could someone with pricing authority review this?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 – price basis 2027 onwards
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We acknowledge your scorecard data and have adjusted our calculation accordingly. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

While we welcome a 24-month commitment, we cannot offer fixed prices over this duration and must include an AS-14404 index clause. Under these revised terms, including 60 days payment, we can offer €5.55 per unit.

Our offer stands at a price of €5.43 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, with a contract term of 24 months and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.55 per unit, featuring a price of €5.55 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Part 370010 – revised term sheets with AS-14404 clause option
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for the revised offer. We understand your need for AS-14404 protection over a longer term, so one of our packages now includes your clause.

Our forecast fc:370010@2026-09 records a +1.9% volume change for this part, so the business on offer is growing.

Our attached packages:
- 36 months, no index clause, 60 days, at EUR 5.42
- 36 months, AS-14404 clause with 5% deadband, 90 days, at EUR 5.40
- 24 months, no index clause, 90 days, at EUR 5.45

Could someone with pricing authority review these? If one works for you, please make it your primary standing offer.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 – revised term sheets with AS-14404 clause option
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Our offer is a price of €5.53 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. As previously stated, we cannot offer fixed prices over a 36-month duration and must include the AS-14404 index clause. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Alternatively, with a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Part 370010 – packages with your AS-14404 clause
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your revised offer. We have accepted your AS-14404 clause with base month 2026-08, so future alloy movements are passed through. The base price therefore does not need a material risk buffer. Your previous offer of EUR 5.43 also included the clause. LCI-C rose only from 116.5 to 119.6 (idx:LCI-C@2026-06, +2.66%), so labour does not justify a higher base.

Our packages, each at 36 months with your clause and a 5% deadband:
- EUR 5.43, 90 days
- EUR 5.40, 60 days

Alternatively, EUR 5.48 with no clause, 90 days, 24 months.

Could someone with pricing authority review these? Please make the one that works your primary standing offer.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 – packages with your AS-14404 clause
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with us. Following a review by our pricing management, we can offer €5.47 per unit for a 36-month contract with 60 days payment terms and the AS-14404 clause. 

To give you the full picture of our commercial conditions, our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.47 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our offer stays valid for 7 days. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

To help us improve the price further, please specify the exact binding volume you can commit to. Which volume can you commit to? Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. 

For your information, material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 – packages with your AS-14404 clause
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached. We are delighted to serve you and remain committed to supporting your needs with our broad range and reliable service. We look forward to continuing our successful partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
